serving_mode.description: Natural measurement mode. 'item' = countable whole units (egg, yogurt); 'weight' = grams (rice, meat); 'volume' = mL (milk, oil); 'measure' = culinary units (salt, spices). Absent = weight by default.

unit_label_fr.description: French display label for one unit when serving_mode is 'item' (e.g. 'oeuf'). Required when serving_mode = item.

unit_label_en.description: English display label for one unit when serving_mode is 'item' (e.g. 'egg'). Required when serving_mode = item.

states.description: Per-state metadata keyed by preparation state. Each key is the state in which the metadata applies.

portion_g.description: Typical serving size in grams in this state.

density_g_ml.description: Volumetric density (g/mL) for unit conversion in this state.

can_eat_raw.description: Can this ingredient be consumed without cooking?

can_eat_cooked.description: Can this ingredient be cooked and eaten cooked?

typical_state.description: The usual preparation state for this ingredient

aliases_en.description: Alternative English names for search indexing

aliases_fr.description: Alternative French names for search indexing

serving_unit_types.description: Culinary unit types that apply to this ingredient (resolved to grams via serving_unit_types.yaml)

display_unit.description: Whether quantity should be displayed in grams or millilitres in the UI

absorption_factors.description: Fraction of each nutrient absorbed by the body from this ingredient (0.0–1.0). Absent key = no adjustment applied.
